core_job: For adults in the U.S. (18+ gate, U.S. ZIP and state layers): meet a real person near you, one ring at a time (your ZIP area, then county, then state, then everywhere), and get to a first message. Location is stored only as ZIP-3, county and state, and no distance is ever shown. Today this cannot complete, for three reasons. (1) The driftdate schema is not deployed: Backend PR #1 is waiting on founder approval in issue #19. (2) driftdate.can_send_message requires verified_at on both people, and nothing can set it because verify-selfie was never deployed, so every chat is locked. (3) Sign-up depends on phone OTP, and whether an SMS provider is configured is not verified.
signature: Safe Meet, a new tab that works entirely on the device. Before a date you make a plan: who (a match, or a typed first name), where, the start time and when you expect to be done. When the person is a match, the plan shows their real trust facts (email confirmed, Apple or Google sign-in, member since, the ring you matched in). One tap sends the plan to a trusted contact through Messages (sms:) or the share sheet; the app does not send texts itself. At the end time a local notification asks "Are you home safe?", with a second reminder 15 minutes later. "Need help" opens a sheet with Call 911, a pre-filled text to the contact, and Share plan. A plan can be made for a typed name, so it works on a fresh account with no matches and App Review can use it. I compared the store descriptions of Tinder (547702041), Hinge (595287172) and Bumble (930441707) through the keyless iTunes Lookup API. None of them describes a timed check-in after a date; Bumble describes 'Share Date'. Whether any of them has an in-app check-in that its description leaves out is not verified, because web search was disabled in this session.
must: M1 Sign-up without SMS or a demo account: Get started offers Sign in with Apple, Google, or a new email sign-up (auth.signUp with a confirm-your-inbox state). The phone OTP step leaves onboarding. The profile builder keeps photos, the 18+ date-of-birth gate, intent and rings. Covered by a widget test.

M2 Messaging works: amend Backend PR #1 so can_send_message requires both people to have a confirmed email or phone (plus no block) instead of verified_at, and re-run the PGlite RLS evidence. Deploying it is the founder's decision (#19). Delete the 'not available in this version' locked copy in all 12 locales, add confirm-your-email prompts that keep the draft, and remove the call to the undeployed reply-suggest edge function.

M3 Four real rings, widening one at a time: a bundled Census 2020 ZCTA-to-county map (the file answered HTTP 200 today and needs no key) makes the county layer work on the device without storing the ZIP5. The home is a Ring view with real per-ring counts and one-step 'Widen to X (+N)' and 'Come back in' buttons. 'Server' is renamed 'Everywhere'. No miles or km anywhere, enforced by a test.

M4 Signature Safe Meet: a plan editor, a trusted contact stored only on the device, sms: and share-sheet sending, local notifications at the end time and 15 minutes later, a Need-help sheet (tel:911, text my contact, share), a persisted Upcoming/Active/Past history, and an 'active plan' strip on every tab. No interstitial ads anywhere near it. Unit and widget tests, including survival across a restart.

M5 One honest Trust Passport: merge the Passport and Trust Score screens. Show only checks the app really performs: email, phone only if SMS is enabled, Apple/Google sign-in, member since, profile complete. Delete the identity/SSN/background/financial rows, the 5-star ladder and the weighted score. Add a trust_facts() security-definer function so others see these facts as chips. Remove the unused camera-selfie and microphone permissions, the dead voice_prompt_recorder.dart, and the record and audioplayers dependencies.

M6 Honesty and 5.6 cleanup: replace the six compatibility dials, which have a 55% floor (compatibility.dart:81), with a 'Shared ground' list of true facts. Rename ai_compatibility_screen.dart and use no 'AI' anywhere. Remove the debug DriftDate+ switch and 'Premium (demo)' in 12 locales. No demo login, no remote switches, no detection, no hidden gestures, no invented counts.

M7 Guideline 1.2 safeguards: an on-device objectionable-word filter on name, prompts, vibes and messages that keeps the draft. Report a single message (may need reports.message_id in PR #1). Published safety contact (contact@americangroup.ai) in the Safety Centre and Settings.

M8 Own identity, 'tide rings': mist #F3F5F2, ink #1B2A2F, seed lagoon #134E5E, accent apricot #F2A65A, ring colours #F2A65A/#E07A5F/#3D8C95/#6C7A89 (grep found none of these in 42 app lib trees or in the other specs). Instrument Serif for headings and Figtree for body, both bundled (no match in the grep). Card radius 20. CupertinoTabBar on iOS with Nearby, Matches, Safe Meet and You. The banner leaves the spot above the tab bar. New ring icon replacing the double heart and making the assets consistent, and a new splash (storyboard and assets only, never pbxproj). Remove 'Get started', 'Welcome back', 'Find Real People', 'It's a Match!'.

M9 Depth: persisted ring choice, plans, trusted contact and chat drafts. Matches search, ring and unread filters. Safe Meet filters and sharing. Real-count empty states for each ring, an offline strip that disables writes, and Safe Meet working fully offline.

M10 Proven: flutter analyze shows 0 issues, the full test suite passes, and new tests cover M1-M9 plus absence greps. A release build is launched on a physical iPhone if available, otherwise labelled simulator-only, to check the 2.1(a) crash. Screenshots are viewed before calling it done. Commits are path-limited and never touch fastlane/** or project.pbxproj, which are dirty at base. Backend changes go only on the driftdate-schema PR branch.
